test_sequence_basic_execution: test the Sequence option to execute a list of child options in order until all succeed
test_sequence_failure_on_option_failure: test the Sequence option to terminate with FAILURE when a child option fails and terminate_on_option_failure is True
test_sequence_nested_with_cond: test a nested Sequence composed with Cond options to verify correct branching and counter tracking
test_sequence_single_child_wrapper: test a Sequence wrapping a single child option to verify pterm and result propagation
test_sequence_timestep_ordering: test that the first option receives a LAST timestep before the second option receives a FIRST timestep
